defaults.travelStyle: Private tailor-made – dates and pace confirmed on enquiry

defaults.logisticsNote: Park fees, permits and lodge blocks are arranged after you confirm dates. Final drive times depend on season, road conditions and your target stops.
defaults.seasonalityFallback: See our tour calendar for regional seasons, then enquire for this route.
defaults.accommodationUnconfirmed: Lodges and camps are named in your written proposal once dates are fixed – not all properties are pre-published on this page.
defaults.whyChooseFallback: This route is built for field time: listening points, forest trails and realistic drives – not a checklist coach tour.
defaults.travellerFallback: Serious birders, listers and photographers; mixed-interest couples when wildlife modules are added on enquiry.
defaults.wildlifePhotoFallback: Wildlife and scenic opportunities appear on drives and at camp; photographers should ask us to weight the schedule toward light and stake-out time.

14-days-southern-tanzania-birding-tour.whyChoose: Two weeks in the Southern circuit heartland – arc forests, miombo and wetland edges with time for Udzungwa, Ruaha and Kilombero contexts without rushing single-day hops.
14-days-southern-tanzania-birding-tour.travellerProfile: Listers and photographers targeting southern endemics and miombo specials who accept drive days between forests.
14-days-southern-tanzania-birding-tour.wildlifePhoto: Elephants, antelope and cats possible on Ruaha and wetland legs; forest bird photography needs patience on arc trails.
14-days-southern-tanzania-birding-tour.seasonality: Often planned in drier months (May–Nov) for miombo and track access; forests bird year-round with weather flexibility.
14-days-southern-tanzania-birding-tour.mapNote: Stops are approximate planning points for discussion – not GPS navigation or sensitive species locations.

19-days-southern-tanzania-birding-trip.whyChoose: An intensive southern sweep with miombo, Ruvuma-border country, Selous/Nyerere context and Rondo plateau forest – for guests who want the full inventory-style southern route.
19-days-southern-tanzania-birding-trip.travellerProfile: Experienced birders comfortable with bush camps, long drives and variable lodge standards.
19-days-southern-tanzania-birding-trip.editorialBanner: Day 19 is not broken out separately in the published schedule below. A second southern listing shares the same routing – enquire so we match you to the right departure and pacing.
habitats: Coastal birding near Dar es Salaam
19-days-southern-tanzania-birding-trip.seasonality: Dry-season planning preferred for miombo tracks and camp access; confirm with us before booking.

19-days-southern-endemic-birding.editorialBanner: This journey follows the same southern routing as our 19-day southern birding trip – tell us your target list and we will confirm which title fits your dates.

20-day-endemic-birds-southern.whyChoose: A southern endemic arc from Dar es Salaam through Mikumi, Udzungwa, Nyerere (Selous), Ruaha and Kitulo – suited to guests wanting parks and plateau habitats in one long route.
20-day-endemic-birds-southern.editorialBanner: Some day numbers in the outline below skip or repeat – contact us for the latest operating version with corrected day-by-day timings.
20-day-endemic-birds-southern.travellerProfile: Guests wanting a broad southern habitat sample with wildlife parks and montane grassland (Kitulo).

8-days-northern-tarangire-manyara-ngoron.whyChoose: Classic northern circuit from Tarangire’s elephant rivers through Ngorongoro Crater and multi-day Serengeti time via Olduvai Gorge – aligned to the owner’s SAFARIS TANZANIA itinerary document.
8-days-northern-tarangire-manyara-ngoron.travellerProfile: First-time Tanzania visitors and wildlife photographers wanting migration context, crater descent and Manyara’s tree-climbing lions on one route.
8-days-northern-tarangire-manyara-ngoron.wildlifePhoto: Golden-hour plains in Serengeti, crater rim viewpoints, Tarangire baobabs and elephant herds; Manyara forest-light for lions in trees.
8-days-northern-tarangire-manyara-ngoron.seasonality: Year-round; Great Migration sectors vary by month – June onward for northbound herds per the published safari copy.

20-day-endemic-birding-tanzania.whyChoose: National endemic tour spanning Pemba, Uluguru, Ukaguru, Udzungwa, Kilombero, Mikumi and Usambara forests – a country-wide arc and island module.
20-day-endemic-birding-tanzania.editorialBanner: A different route from our 20-day southern endemic tour. The outline below may skip days 12–13 – enquire for the full twenty-day schedule.
20-day-endemic-birding-tanzania.mapNote: Approximate corridor for planning – verify on enquiry.

22-days-endemic-birding-tours.whyChoose: The flagship multi-region endemic tour – Usambara, eastern transit, Udzungwa, southern links and Pemba when scheduled – for comprehensive Tanzania listers.
22-days-endemic-birding-tours.editorialBanner: The published outline may not list every calendar day of this 22-day flagship – we will send the operational schedule when you confirm dates.
22-days-endemic-birding-tours.travellerProfile: Dedicated listers on a once-in-a-lifetime Tanzania endemic circuit who accept complex logistics.

13-days-northern-tanzania-birding.whyChoose: A northern Tanzania pilgrimage route – Lark Plains endemic lark, crater rhinos, Serengeti cats and Ndutu calving meadows when timed to the rains.
13-days-northern-tanzania-birding.travellerProfile: First-time Tanzania visitors and mammal photographers who still want a serious northern bird list.
13-days-northern-tanzania-birding.seasonality: Apr calving season popular for birds in breeding plumage; Jun–Aug for dry-season wildlife viewing.

15-days-tanzania-birding-tour.whyChoose: Our classic northern-to-eastern arc link – Serengeti mammal country and Usambara forest endemics on one private route from Arusha, without rushing forest days.
15-days-tanzania-birding-tour.travellerProfile: Listers and photographers wanting parks plus Eastern Arc specials on a single two-week itinerary.
15-days-tanzania-birding-tour.seasonality: Serengeti sectors vary by month; arc forests bird year-round – we match Ndutu, river crossings or forest targets to your dates.
15-days-tanzania-birding-tour.editorialBanner: Combines well with our southern endemic modules on a longer tailor-made tour – ask about a Mega Tanzania birding quote.

7-days-tanzania-budget-birding.whyChoose: Maximum arc endemics per day without the full northern park loop – suited to guests combining a short birding week with Kilimanjaro or Zanzibar.
7-days-tanzania-budget-birding.travellerProfile: Budget-conscious birders and repeat visitors who already know the northern parks.
7-days-tanzania-budget-birding.seasonality: Year-round; confirm South Pare access in heavy rains.

23-days-ultimate-tanzania-birding.whyChoose: Flagship cross-country endemic route – southern Udzungwa and Kilombero modules, Pemba island endemics and Usambara forests in one extended private itinerary.
23-days-ultimate-tanzania-birding.travellerProfile: Dedicated listers accepting camping nights, domestic flights and long drives between arc blocks.
habitats: Eastern Arc montane and scarp forest
23-days-ultimate-tanzania-birding.editorialBanner: Northern Serengeti–Arusha extension (approx. 7 days) available as an add-on – not included in the 23-day outline below unless quoted.
23-days-ultimate-tanzania-birding.seasonality: Often scheduled Jul–Aug; confirm Udzungwa camping and flight blocks for your year.
